messages.content: "Can you help me with some gaming information? First, I want to know about the rewards I can get from playing 'Call of Duty' on my 'Playstation'. Second, I am curious about the scores and rankings on level 3 of 'FIFA' on 'Xbox'. Third, I would like to know all the missions for 'Assassin Creed'. Lastly, I want to know the rewards for the 'Master' trophy level in 'Fortnite' on my 'PC'."

function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores.

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards.

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards.

message.reasoning:
We need to call functions. We have four requests:

1. Rewards for Call of Duty on Playstation. Use game_rewards_get with game="Call of Duty", platform="Playstation", mission default "", trophy default "".

2. Scores and rankings on level 3 of FIFA on Xbox. Use game_scores_get with game="FIFA", platform="Xbox", level=3, player default "".

3. All missions for Assassin Creed. Use game_missions_list with game="Assassin Creed".

4. Rewards for Master trophy level in Fortnite on PC. Use game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="PC", mission default "", trophy="Master".
